scope: Windows 11 and Android release dependency review

go_orchestrator.remaining_windows_go_packages: All remaining Go test packages passed with the locked toolchain and vendored dependencies.

gateway_http2.finding: Actix HTTP still selects h2 0.3.27. The RustSec fix is published for h2 0.4.16.
gateway_http2.applicability: The LAN media gateway uses Actix HTTPS. The fixed h2 series changes HTTP types, and the released Actix dependency still uses 0.3. The Actix native backend migration is in draft. When a supported migration is available, verify the Windows runtime dependency tree and retest HTTPS, WebSocket, media and shutdown on that artifact.

additional_windows_gateway_review.observed_path: Windows gateway -> moonlight-common -> rsa 0.9.10. RustCryptoBackend uses RSA private operations for GameStream pairing.
additional_windows_gateway_review.scope: The private key in this path belongs to the GameStream client identity; the LAN management and gateway server TLS keys have separate ownership. The upstream timing issue remains relevant to reviewing authenticated pairing and the trusted renderer boundary.
